title: HtmlQ
responsibility: Renders the native q element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlQ.attributes
inputs.description: Native q attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlQ.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native q element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlQ
outputs.description: The actual native q element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
